companyHint: The company that owns this lead. It cannot change after the lead is created.
branchHint: The branch that owns this lead. It cannot change after the lead is created.
ownerHint: The person responsible for following up. Leave it empty to assign it to yourself.
ownerOwn: You can assign leads only to yourself.
tagsHint: Up to 50 tags. Type to search or create a new tag.
tagsHintNoCreate: Up to 50 tags. Type to search.
valueHint: The estimated deal size, with its currency. Up to 3 decimals.
addressExisting: The selected company keeps its saved address.
legalNameHint: The registered name. If empty, the company name is used.
taxNumberHint: Up to 64 characters, as on official documents.
descriptionHint: General notes about this lead, up to 2000 characters.
interestHint: What the lead is interested in, up to 4000 characters.
needHint: What the lead is expected to need, up to 4000 characters.
